name: brain
description: Governed semantic tool layer over private knowledge.sqlite. FastMCP supports local stdio and opt-in Streamable HTTP without exposing raw SQL.
env_notes: Paths are populated by the installer when discovered. HTTP is opt-in via --transport http or BRAIN_MCP_TRANSPORT=http and binds to 0.0.0.0 by default. Set BRAIN_API_KEY only through deployment secrets; installers never write it into host configs.
